Markets.title: US Markets Today: US stocks end lower as Alphabet revenue miss revives AI capex jitters
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower after Alphabet's revenue miss sparked concerns about artificial intelligence spending. The Nasdaq Composite suffered the steepest decline, dropping by 1.36 percent.

Markets.title: Cash takes centre stage as investors rethink AI spending boom
Markets.summary: Investors are increasingly prioritizing tech companies' cash generation to fund artificial intelligence investments. While Microsoft and Oracle are gaining positive attention for their strong financial positions, Alphabet faces concerns because its AI spending has surpassed its operating cash flow.

Markets.title: Alphabet’s AI risks deepen as filing reveals $98 billion in commitments beyond the $1 trillion spending
Markets.summary: Alphabet disclosed financial risks from massive AI investments exceeding $1 trillion in a recent regulatory filing. The company faces nearly $98.5 billion in contingent commitments, including data center leases and chip system repurchases.

Markets.title: Sagility block deal: Promoter Sagility BV likely to sell 12% stake for Rs 2,377 crore
Markets.summary: Sagility promoter Sagility B.V. plans to sell a 12% stake in the healthcare IT services firm for Rs 2,377 crore through a block deal. This news follows the company's Q2 FY27 report showing 22.5% revenue growth and 8.1% adjusted profit growth.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Driven by the Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady, lower crude prices, and strong institutional buying, Indian equities rallied over 1% on Thursday. This market surge added nearly ₹5 lakh crore in total market value, with the Sensex gaining 905 points and the Nifty rising 238 points.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Eternal among 2 stocks to buy for Friday for healthy returns
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets rallied following the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady, lower crude prices, and renewed institutional buying. Technical analysts recommend buying Adani Ports and Eternal on Friday due to their bullish momentum and breakout levels.

Geo-Political.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
Geo-Political.summary: Leaked audio from a deadly Spanish train crash reveals that one high-speed train was given clearance to travel at normal speed. This permission was granted even though another train had stalled on the tracks ahead.

Geo-Political.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone attack on a train station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro killed at least 14 people. At least 14 others were wounded, including an 11-year-old boy.

Geo-Political.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
Geo-Political.summary: After losing the presidential election, Flávio Bolsonaro declared himself the leader of Brazil's political opposition. He announced that he will direct this opposition movement from the United States.

Geo-Political.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
Geo-Political.summary: Philippine police obtained a warrant to search electronic devices belonging to Thomas Markle. The search is connected to reports that images of child sexual abuse were found in his former home in the Philippines.

Geo-Political.title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
Geo-Political.summary: A temporary ceasefire has brought a brief period of peace and normal life to the city of Kherson. However, residents are living in fear of what will happen when the fighting resumes.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
Geo-Political.summary: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen outlined her vision for a new partnership at a Montreal summit. She continued to describe Canada as an "associate member" despite opposition from some EU nations, including Germany.

Data & Insights.title: Economy can sustain high-growth trajectory in FY27, recent GST reforms to help: Finmin review
Data & Insights.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that recent GST reforms will help the Indian economy maintain a high-growth trajectory in the 2026-27 financial year. However, the Department of Economic Affairs warned that elevated global oil prices and inflation continue to pose risks requiring constant vigilance.

Data & Insights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang names 3 countries leading in tech, manufacturing: Which are they? Does India make the list?
Data & Insights.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified the US, China, and Taiwan as the world's leading nations in advanced technology and manufacturing. India was excluded from this list of top three countries.

Data & Insights.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
Data & Insights.summary: India's public debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to decline from 84.3% in fiscal year 2026 to 75.1% by fiscal year 2032. This makes India the only emerging market economy with a GDP exceeding $1 trillion expected to reduce its public debt ratio during this period.

Data & Insights.title: Industrial output growth a tad slower at 6.7% in September, expansion led by manufacturing, electricity generation
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 8% in August. This expansion was driven by strong performances in manufacturing and electricity generation despite a decline in mining.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet approves PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana for 2026-31 with  ₹7,395 crore outlay to strengthen Panchayat governance
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana with a ₹7,395.55 crore outlay for 2026-31. The scheme will strengthen governance across more than 2.55 lakh Panchayats and benefit approximately 32 lakh elected representatives and functionaries.

Data & Insights.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
Data & Insights.summary: India's industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September, missing expectations of 7.3% as manufacturing and electricity growth moderated and mining contracted. Despite the September slowdown, industrial production grew 6.8% during the first half of the fiscal year from April to September.

India.title: Jamia Finally Sets Dates For Restoring Students' Union, Protest Ends With 'Victory' Celebrations
India.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia has finally announced dates for restoring its students' union and holding elections following ongoing student protests. The protest officially ended with celebration after the administration agreed to the restoration terms.

India.title: Rohini Acharya's 'Tejashwi Yadav + Prashant Kishor' Equation For Bihar
India.summary: Rohini Acharya stated that the BJP always benefits from a fragmented opposition in Bihar. She suggested that uniting the opposition to prevent vote splitting makes defeating the BJP entirely possible.

India.title: Devendra Fadnavis, Thackeray Cousins Trade Hilarious Jibes At Book Launch
India.summary: Culture Minister Ashish Shelar praised Devendra Fadnavis for accepting Raj Thackeray's event invitation to promote unity in art and culture. During the book launch, Fadnavis and the Thackeray cousins exchanged humorous political remarks.

India.title: Nursing Student Found Dead In UP, Family Says Principal, Son Killed Her
India.summary: A nursing student was found dead in Uttar Pradesh, and her family accused the college principal and his son of killing her. Following the post-mortem, the family briefly blocked a road at the district headquarters before police persuaded them to disperse and sent the body home.

India.title: Lucknow Triple Murder: 5 Shots Fired In 22 Seconds, Gun Reloaded Mid-Attack, Shows Video
India.summary: A man in Lucknow fatally shot three people following a parking dispute. Captured on video, the attacker fired five shots within 22 seconds, pausing to reload his weapon mid-attack.

India.title: BJP Promises 63% Dearness Allowance To Government Employees If It Comes To Power In Punjab
India.summary: Punjab BJP president Kewal Singh Dhillon criticized the AAP government for failing to meet employee demands. He promised that the BJP will provide a 63% dearness allowance to government employees if the party comes to power in Punjab.

General.title: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
General.summary: Critics have questioned the Budget's lack of detail and timetables regarding welfare reform. In response, Burnham stated his intention to reduce the welfare bill as quickly as possible.

General.title: 'Continue your journey': Key moments of leaked Spain train crash audio
General.summary: Leaked audio recordings indicate that a control center cleared a train to move while another train was stalled on the same track. These communications capture key moments leading up to a train crash in Spain.

General.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over letter about Meghan's father
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police have referred themselves to the police watchdog regarding their handling of a letter containing allegations about Meghan Markle's father. This referral subjects the force to external scrutiny over how they managed the document.

General.title: Jury shown CCTV of Huntingdon train staff using frying pan in defence
General.summary: A Huntingdon court viewed CCTV footage of train staff defending themselves with a frying pan during an incident. Prosecutors described the crew member's actions as showing sheer courage and bravery in seeking to save lives.
